name: Aastamangalam Finance Limited
about: Aastamangalam Finance Limited, a non-banking financial company provides financial services in India. The company offers short-term and long-term financing services to corporate and non-corporate entities, as well as recovery of overdue receivables. The company was formerly known as Upasana Finance Limited and changed its name to Aastamangalam Finance Limited in March 2022. Aastamangalam Finance Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Chennai, India.
